transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just feel worn out almost every day. It's like... even after I get a full night's sleep, my body and my head are still just dragging when I have to get up for my cashier shifts. I just can't seem to shake being so tired.
Alongside feeling so exhausted, have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I don't really feel sad or down in the dumps or anything like that. I'm just... constantly tired. So no, not depressed, just really exhausted all the time.
Have you been struggling with excessive worry or feeling anxious about everyday matters?

Yeah, I guess I do. It just... it feels like my mind is always jumping from one thing to the next. I'll be worrying about money, and then it's the relative staying with us, or how stressed my wife is. Then I start thinking about my church duties, or whether I'm messing up at work. It's just everyday stuff, but my brain just keeps bouncing between all of it.
Do you find it difficult to control or stop these worries once they start?

Yeah, it really is. I mean, I try telling myself to just pray on it, or to just leave it alone. But... it doesn't really work. Once a worry starts, it just keeps rolling right into another one, and before I know it, I'm just thinking through every bad way the day could go.
How long have you been dealing with this constant worrying?
I'd say it's been going on for about a year and three months now. That's right around the time our older relative moved in with us, and it's just been like this ever since then.
